title: App pages: block grids declare columns and fold by breakpoint; the page description sits under its title
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11` at 1024 px, HotCRM's Sales Home page (`/page/sales_home_page`, `src/sales/pages/home.page.ts`): the four KPI blocks under "Key Performance Indicators" stack one per row, each a full-width card with one number, so the first screen is four stripes; the page's description "Sales team home page with key metrics, my open work and upcoming events" is drawn as a muted line above the title "Sales Dashboard" (the page header draws description, then title), and the Edit pencil floats at the top right.

## Target

1. A page region's blocks lay out on a 12-column grid: a block declares `span` (default 12 for lists and tables, 3 for metric tiles, 6 for charts) and the renderer folds spans by breakpoint (≥1280: as declared; 768–1279: tiles 6, charts 12; <768: 12). The page designer in Studio shows the span on the block card.
2. The page header is the console page header (objectui#12553): icon, title, then the description under it, actions at the right.
3. If the page spec has no `span` field, the card says so and files the spec change on objectstack-ai/objectstack; the folding rule still lands with kind-based defaults.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.tsx` and the runtime page renderer, `packages/plugin-dashboard` tiles when used in pages, the page spec in `packages/spec` if `span` is new, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: four metric blocks render in one row at 1280 px and two rows at 1024 px; the description is after the title in the DOM.
2. Screenshots of Sales Home at 1024 and 1280 px.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `b72c97985`, never merged): [hotcrm-sales-home-kpi-stacked.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b72c97985/docs/design/hotcrm-review-2026-10-16/hotcrm-sales-home-kpi-stacked.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 walk of HotCRM's core pages as a user: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en). The maintainer asked for the findings to be filed on the repository each belongs to, verbatim: 「相关问题也在对应的项目上创建任务」.</sub>
